a.lede: Hosts are threatening to leave the platform after Airbnb says that they can no longer require guests to strip beds or do other time-consuming cleaning chores.
a.title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts

b.lede: Any chores that a cleaner might do are no longer deemed reasonable requests for visitors.
b.title: Airbnb bans hosts from making you do the dishes
